opening.text: I have pain in my belly, and it's a cramping pain. I've been vomiting and I've had watery diarrhea. The belly pain, vomiting and diarrhea have been going on for several weeks. I also have some yellowish patches on my eyelids. I have type 2 diabetes, high blood pressure, and I've been told my cholesterol levels are abnormal.
